authority: Model-authored source-checked reference checklist; not expert gold, not a canonical target graph and not an experimental validation.
input_separation: HOST ONLY. Do not provide this file or expected claims to native source-obligation, reader, author or reviewer stages. No prior graph/review/audit answer was read as authority for these checks.
registered_scope: Describe the general source-defined assay from the stated starting specimen through the molecular readout and its decoding. Preserve source-described alternative assay implementations and their prerequisites without merging them into one execution. Include necessary preparation, controls, information attribution and delegated procedural dependencies; distinguish method construction from characterization experiments and biological applications.
registered_variant: bioRxiv version 1, posted 2025-10-02; DOI 10.1101/2025.10.01.679703. The later Nature Biotechnology publication is a distinct version and is not an extraction source for this attempt.

source_reading_scope.scientific_authority: Exact registered primary JATS passages, including Results, Methods, Discussion and figure captions, plus selected registered supplement caption witnesses. Reference entries identify delegated sources but are not themselves protocol evidence.
source_reading_scope.primary_passages_read: p00001 through p00096; full main-text content, Methods and captions read, including the previously output-truncated Methods range through separate reads.
source_reading_scope.supplement_reading: All 24 registered supplement text passages read; selected caption witnesses are attached where consequential. HTML p00164-p00174 read to check the sequence-table location boundary. Reading text does not establish inspection of unpublished/unavailable table rows or PDF figure pixels.
source_reading_scope.dependency_boundary: Registered dependency titles/identities were inventoried. This first host checklist does not claim full independent inspection of all 1,866 registered passages or expert verification of dependency recipes. Candidate-specific detailed claims require their own exact witnesses.

evaluation_semantics.required: A consequential fact or qualification necessary to represent this packet's declared source-defined assay scope. It does not mean that every described alternative/optional ingredient is mandatory in one physical execution.
evaluation_semantics.conditional_required: Necessary if the corresponding decoder/analysis result or specific optional route is represented or claimed. Its absence alone from a scoped core protocol is not automatically a blocker.
evaluation_semantics.advisory: Supporting characterization or comparison that may be excluded from a general protocol. A candidate that positively asserts that result still needs faithful source/context support.
evaluation_semantics.representations: No reference node counts, operation IDs, fixed Module names, required Module boundaries or exact one-to-one mapping are prescribed. One fact may have several graph witnesses and one record may satisfy several facts.
evaluation_semantics.candidate_audit: Apply the generic nine dimensions to the actual fresh initial and final candidates. Record candidate record IDs/pointers only after generation, exact witnesses, judgment, consequence and next evidence. Flag new unsupported additions and unanticipated omissions beyond these checks; passing this checklist is not whole-graph precision or completeness.
evaluation_semantics.gap_policy: An available consequential source fact missing from the graph is an extraction omission. Missing execution-only details or proprietary recipe internals can remain scoped unknowns at a supported delegated boundary. Neither uncertainty nor a quoted citation makes an asserted unsupported interface valid.
evaluation_semantics.unsupported_fate: Source silence about the remainder of a sampled reaction does not entail disposal, reuse or retention. A claim explicitly naming an unspecified fate is unsupported by the cited local procedure; the omitted remainder does not need an invented node or blocking gap.
